_readme: Declared skips for the @smoke suite, keyed by target. Read by scripts/run-smoke.mjs.
A skip is permitted ONLY if it appears here with a reason. An undeclared skip fails
the run, and so does a declaration that no longer matches a real skip, because a stale
exemption is how a suite quietly stops being run.
Declaring a skip does NOT make the flow proven. It makes the gap named, and the runner
prints what the run did not cover. Every entry here is a debt with an owner.
Keyed by target because the same spec legitimately RUNS on sandbox (where
ALLOW_TEST_HELPERS is set) and cannot run on production (where it correctly is not).
A blanket exemption would have excused a real gap on sandbox too.

production./dashboard/inspections/new renders for a: UNPROVEN ON PRODUCTION. trial-no-paywall.spec.ts signs in via /api/test/sign-in-as, gated behind ALLOW_TEST_HELPERS, which production correctly does not set. Closing this needs a seeded production trial account the smoke can authenticate as -- founder-gated, it is a credential. Until then production smoke proves nothing about a trial user reaching first value.
production./dashboard/reports/new renders for a TRI: UNPROVEN ON PRODUCTION. Same cause and same remedy as the inspections leg above.
production.connects via mocked OAuth and shows 'Con: Quarantined at source: setup-storage-google-drive.spec.ts is marked test.fixme. Recorded in the estate as restoreassist-gdrive-smoke-quarantine. It is declared here so the quarantine is visible in every run rather than only in the spec file.
